blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all current views and poses: in crouch and sit, shorts do not maintain continuous upper-thigh and center coverage; exposed thigh and the inner center gap remain visible. In neutral and standing views the shorts still descend to around the knee with an overly tubular silhouette. Bilateral centerline weights did not visually resolve the coverage defect. Fit and continuous clearance remain unverified.

Direct inspection of pose renders: the overskirt rear panels fold inward into bulky angular flaps in crouch and sit and collapse across the back/legs in prone. Standing flare remains uneven. Pleat order and motion remain visually rejected.

Directly inspected front and three-quarter views: diagonal placket and button-like details are visible, but the images do not establish fastening or retention during movement. Closure security and measured waist fit remain unapproved.

Direct inspection of neutral, arms-up and arm-cross poses: sleeves and underarm show faceted folds; the collar ends as an open, cut-off neck rim on this headless pose model. Surface quality, head clearance and strain remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
